this handoff itself required an explicit, detailed human-issued instruction to begin, the same manual-trigger dependency already retained as an unresolved risk for SB-ORG-LEARNING-1.1 (GitHub Issue #590, Stage 4B) -- Stage 4B background automation remains deferred and unimplemented, so this recurrence is expected, not new
